<!doctype html>
<html lang="ja">
<head><base href="https://therev-lab.com/"><script>(() => {
 const currentPage="recovery";
 const parentFile=parent.location.href.split('#')[0];
 const origin='https://therev-lab.com';
 function routeFrom(href){
  if(href.startsWith('#'))return {page:currentPage,anchor:decodeURIComponent(href.slice(1))};
  let u;try{u=new URL(href,origin+(currentPage==='recovery'?'/solution.html':'/'));}catch{return null;}
  if(u.origin!==origin)return null;
  if(u.pathname==='/'||u.pathname==='/index.html')return {page:'top',anchor:decodeURIComponent(u.hash.slice(1))};
  if(u.pathname==='/solution.html')return {page:'recovery',anchor:decodeURIComponent(u.hash.slice(1))};
  return null;
 }
 function wireLinks(){
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(a=>{
   // Preserve the TOP's menu-selecting trial links and hash state.
   if(a.hasAttribute('data-trial'))return;
   const original=a.dataset.revOriginalHref||a.getAttribute('href');
   if(!original)return;
   const route=routeFrom(original);
   if(!route){
    let u;try{u=new URL(original,origin+'/');}catch{return;}
    if(u.origin===origin){
     if(a.getAttribute('href')!==u.href)a.setAttribute('href',u.href);
     if(!a.hasAttribute('target'))a.setAttribute('target','_top');
    }
    return;
   }
   const href=parentFile+'#/'+route.page+(route.anchor?'/'+encodeURIComponent(route.anchor):'');
   a.dataset.revOriginalHref=original;
   a.dataset.revPage=route.page;
   a.dataset.revAnchor=route.anchor;
   if(a.getAttribute('href')!==href)a.setAttribute('href',href);
  });
 }
 document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const a=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('a');
  if(!a||a.hasAttribute('data-trial'))return;
  const href=a.dataset.revOriginalHref||a.getAttribute('href')||'';
  const route=a.dataset.revPage?{page:a.dataset.revPage,anchor:a.dataset.revAnchor||''}:routeFrom(href);
  if(!route||e.button!==0||e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey||e.shiftKey||e.altKey)return;
  e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();
  document.dispatchEvent(new Event('rev-preview-navigation'));
  parent.postMessage({type:'rev-integrated-navigate',...route},'*');
 },true);
 const watch=()=>{
  wireLinks();
  new MutationObserver(wireLinks).observe(document.documentElement,{subtree:true,childList:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['href']});
 };
 if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',watch,{once:true});else watch();
 window.__REV_INTEGRATED_PAGE__=currentPage;
})();
</script>

@media print{.rv-sticky,.rv-header-book,.rv-header nav{display:none!important}body{padding-bottom:0}details>div{display:block}h2,h3{break-after:avoid}article,figure{break-inside:avoid}}

/* V2-D R1: consumer benefits first; evidence available on demand. */
.rv-benefit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:30px}.rv-benefit-grid article{border-top:1px solid var(--rv-line);padding:25px 0 10px}.rv-benefit-grid h3{font-family:var(--rv-serif);font-size:29px;font-weight:400;margin:18px 0}.rv-benefit-grid article>p:not(.rv-label){font-size:16px}.rv-benefit-note{margin-top:25px;max-width:850px}.rv-evidence-drawer{margin-top:28px}.rv-evidence-drawer>div>p{max-width:850px}.rv-evidence-drawer .rv-study-grid{margin:26px 0}.rv-evidence-drawer .rv-outcomes{margin-top:28px}.rv-denba-features{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:28px 0}.rv-denba-features span{border:1px solid #747767;padding:8px 12px;font-size:12px;color:#e7e2d7}.rv-denba-details{border-color:#64685c;margin-top:22px}.rv-denba-details summary{font-size:14px}.rv-denba-details summary:after{color:#cfb88f}.rv-denba-details>div{font-size:14px;color:#d2d2c6}.rv-denba-details p{margin-top:16px}.rv-denba-details .rv-source{margin-bottom:10px}
@media(max-width:800px){.rv-benefit-grid{gap:20px}.rv-benefit-grid h3{font-size:24px}.rv-benefit-grid article>p:not(.rv-label){font-size:15px}}
@media(max-width:600px){.rv-benefit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0}.rv-benefit-grid article{padding:24px 0}.rv-benefit-grid h3{font-size:26px;margin:13px 0}.rv-benefit-note{margin-top:15px;font-size:12px}.rv-evidence-drawer{margin-top:24px}.rv-evidence-drawer summary{font-size:14px}.rv-denba-features{margin:23px 0;gap:8px}.rv-denba-features span{font-size:11px;padding:7px 9px}.rv-denba-details summary{font-size:13px}.rv-denba-details>div{font-size:14px}}

/* Final R2 — visual refinement of the approved R1. */
:root { --rv-line:#d4cec3; --rv-muted:#5e6259; }
body { line-height:1.95; }
p { line-break:strict; overflow-wrap:break-word; }
h1,h2,h3 { line-break:strict; }
.rv-frame { width:min(1200px,calc(100% - 112px)); }
.rv-header { padding-top:24px; padding-bottom:24px; }
.rv-header nav { gap:32px; }
.rv-header nav a { font-size:13px; }
.rv-button { min-height:56px; padding:15px 25px; letter-spacing:.025em; transition:background .18s,color .18s; }
.rv-header-book { min-height:48px; }
.rv-button>span { font-size:17px; font-weight:400; }
.rv-textlink { transition:color .18s; }
.rv-textlink:hover { color:var(--rv-wood); }
a:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #8a6634; outline-offset:5px; }
.rv-denba a:focus-visible,.rv-denba summary:focus-visible,.rv-book a:focus-visible,.rv-trial a:focus-visible { outline-color:#e6c896; }
.rv-kicker { font-size:11px; letter-spacing:1.65px; font-weight:400; }
.rv-label { font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.075em; font-weight:400; }
.rv-hero { width:min(1312px,calc(100% - 112px)); grid-template-columns:46% 54%; margin-top:48px; }
.rv-hero-copy { padding:20px 56px 22px 0; }
.rv-category { margin-top:22px; font-size:14px; }
.rv-hero h1 { font-size:clamp(42px,4.2vw,64px); line-height:1.48; letter-spacing:-.025em; margin-top:30px; }
.rv-hero-lead { font-size:17px; line-height:2; margin-top:28px; }
.rv-hero-tags { margin-top:25px; font-size:12px; gap:14px; }
.rv-hero-tags>span+span { padding-left:14px; }
.rv-hero-offer { padding:18px 0; margin:28px 0 22px; }
.rv-hero-offer p { font-size:13px; gap:10px; }
.rv-hero-offer b { font-size:17px; margin-left:7px; }
.rv-hero-offer strong { font-size:40px; letter-spacing:-1px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.rv-hero-offer>span { font-size:12px; margin-top:8px; }
.rv-actions { gap:22px; }
.rv-hero-hint { font-size:12px; margin-top:13px; }
.rv-hero-photo { margin-left:20px; }
.rv-hero-photo>img { max-height:756px; object-position:52% 48%; }
.rv-hero-photo figcaption { padding:15px 18px; font-size:11px; background:transparent; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rv-line); }
.rv-photo-index { display:none; }
.rv-hero-bottom { margin-top:24px; padding:24px 0; }
.rv-hero-bottom a { min-height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; }
.rv-section { padding:112px 0; }
.rv-section-head { margin-bottom:56px; gap:64px; }
.rv-section h2 { font-size:clamp(34px,3vw,44px); line-height:1.55; letter-spacing:-.025em; margin-top:23px; }
.rv-head-note { font-size:16px; line-height:2; max-width:420px; }
.rv-benefit-grid { gap:48px; }
.rv-benefit-grid article { padding:29px 0 8px; }
.rv-benefit-grid h3 { font-size:29px; line-height:1.6; margin:22px 0 20px; letter-spacing:-.015em; }
.rv-benefit-grid article>p:not(.rv-label) { font-size:16px; line-height:2; max-width:23em; }
.rv-benefit-note { margin-top:36px; font-size:13px; max-width:850px; }
.rv-evidence-drawer { margin-top:30px; }
.rv-details summary { font-size:16px; font-weight:400; min-height:74px; padding:22px 0; gap:24px; }
.rv-details summary:after { content:'+'; font-family:'Jost',sans-serif; font-size:24px; }
.rv-details[open]>summary:after { content:'−'; }
.rv-details summary:hover { color:var(--rv-wood); }
.rv-details>div { font-size:16px; line-height:2; padding-bottom:30px; }
.rv-details>div>p { max-width:52em; }
.rv-study { padding:34px; }
.rv-study h3 { font-size:28px; line-height:1.6; }
.rv-study>p { line-height:2; }
.rv-study .rv-study-limit { line-height:1.9; }
.rv-source { font-size:13px; }
.rv-mechanism-grid { grid-template-columns:43% 57%; align-items:start; }
.rv-equipment-photo { margin-right:72px; }
.rv-equipment-photo>img { height:630px; object-position:44% 49%; }
.rv-equipment-photo figcaption,.rv-place figcaption,.rv-denba figcaption { font-size:12px; margin-top:16px; }
.rv-mechanism-copy>h3 { font-size:25px; font-weight:400; margin:17px 0 23px; line-height:1.7; }
.rv-mechanism-copy>p { font-size:16px; line-height:2; }
.rv-pressure { padding:24px 0; margin:29px 0 31px; }
.rv-pressure strong b { font-size:38px; letter-spacing:-.6px; }
.rv-pressure .rv-small { font-size:13px; line-height:1.9; margin-top:11px; }
.rv-mechanism-copy .rv-subheading { font-size:21px; margin-top:0; margin-bottom:18px; font-weight:600; }
.rv-plain { margin-top:27px; }
.rv-plain summary { font-size:14px; }
.rv-equation { margin-top:6px; }
.rv-denba { padding:112px 0 104px; }
.rv-denba-grid { grid-template-columns:41% 59%; align-items:center; }
.rv-denba-grid figure { margin-right:82px; }
.rv-denba figure>img { height:540px; object-position:50% 43%; }
.rv-denba h2 { font-size:39px; margin-bottom:32px; }
.rv-denba-grid>div>p { font-size:16px; line-height:2; max-width:38em; }
.rv-denba-grid>div>p+p { margin-top:22px; }
.rv-denba-features { gap:0; margin:31px 0; }
.rv-denba-features span { border:0; padding:0; font-size:13px; line-height:1.9; }
.rv-denba-features span+span { border-left:1px solid #747767; margin-left:16px; padding-left:16px; }
.rv-denba-details summary { font-size:14px; }
.rv-denba-details summary:hover { color:#e6c896; }
.rv-denba-details>div { font-size:15px; }
.rv-occasions>.rv-frame { display:grid; grid-template-columns:35% 65%; column-gap:0; }
.rv-occasions .rv-section-head { display:block; padding-right:64px; margin-bottom:0; }
.rv-occasions .rv-head-note { margin-top:30px; font-size:15px; }
.rv-occasion-grid { display:block; padding-top:0; border-top:0; }
.rv-occasion-grid article { display:grid; grid-template-columns:40px 1fr; column-gap:24px; padding:29px 0 32px; border-top:1px solid var(--rv-line); }
.rv-occasion-grid article:last-child { border-bottom:1px solid var(--rv-line); }
.rv-num { font-size:19px; line-height:1.65; letter-spacing:0; grid-row:1/3; margin-top:4px; }
.rv-occasion-grid h3 { font-size:23px; font-weight:400; margin:0; line-height:1.7; }
.rv-occasion-grid h3 br { display:none; }
.rv-occasion-grid p { grid-column:2; font-size:16px; margin-top:14px; max-width:36em; line-height:2; }
.rv-occasions .rv-small { grid-column:2; margin-top:22px; font-size:13px; }
.rv-first .rv-head-note { padding-top:7px; }
.rv-steps li { padding-top:29px; padding-bottom:31px; padding-right:27px; margin-right:27px; }
.rv-steps h3 { font-size:21px; font-weight:400; margin:21px 0 18px; }
.rv-steps p { font-size:15px; line-height:2; }
.rv-steps li>span { font-size:11px; letter-spacing:1px; }
.rv-safety { padding:32px 38px; margin-top:38px; border-left-width:2px; }
.rv-safety h3 { font-size:18px; margin-bottom:16px; }
.rv-safety p { line-height:2; font-size:14px; }
.rv-safety .rv-small { margin-top:16px; }
.rv-price-grid { gap:32px; }
.rv-trial,.rv-regular { padding:43px 44px 42px; }
.rv-trial h3 { font-size:29px; margin-top:22px; }
.rv-price-number { margin-top:28px; gap:34px; }
.rv-price-number>span { font-size:36px; }
.rv-price-number strong { font-size:57px; letter-spacing:-1.3px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.rv-trial-meta { padding-bottom:24px; margin-top:10px; }
.rv-trial>p:not([class]) { font-size:15px; line-height:1.95; margin-top:25px; }
.rv-trial .rv-button { margin-top:29px; }
.rv-regular h3 { font-size:23px; font-weight:400; margin-top:22px; }
.rv-regular dl { margin-top:27px; }
.rv-regular dl>div { padding:17px 0; }
.rv-regular dt { font-family:'Jost',sans-serif; font-size:27px; font-weight:400; }
.rv-regular dd { font-size:32px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.rv-regular>.rv-small { font-size:13px; line-height:1.95; margin-top:27px; }
.rv-price>.rv-frame>.rv-details { margin-top:30px; }
.rv-price>.rv-frame>.rv-details+.rv-details { margin-top:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rv-line); }
.rv-tickets table { font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.rv-tickets th,.rv-tickets td { padding-top:19px; padding-bottom:19px; }
.rv-place { padding:104px 0; }
.rv-place-grid { grid-template-columns:43% 57%; }
.rv-place-grid>div { padding-right:64px; }
.rv-place h2 { font-size:40px; margin-bottom:30px; }
.rv-place p:not(.rv-kicker) { font-size:16px; line-height:2; }
.rv-place .rv-textlink { margin-top:30px; }
.rv-place figure>img { height:470px; object-position:50% 45%; }
.rv-faq-grid { grid-template-columns:38% 62%; }
.rv-faq-grid>div:first-child { padding-right:64px; }
.rv-faq h2 { font-size:36px; }
.rv-faq .rv-details>div { font-size:16px; }
.rv-faq .rv-details summary { min-height:82px; }
.rv-book { padding:112px 0; }
.rv-book-grid { grid-template-columns:46% 54%; }
.rv-book-grid>div:first-child { padding-right:72px; }
.rv-book h2 { font-size:44px; margin-bottom:30px; }

.rv-denba-grid>div>p { max-width:39em; }
.rv-denba-grid>div>p strong { font-weight:600; }
.rv-denba-values { margin-top:30px; border-top:1px solid #737967; }
.rv-denba-values>div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:25px 180px 1fr; gap:18px; padding:17px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #737967; align-items:start; }
.rv-denba-values span { font:12px/2 'Jost',sans-serif; color:#cfb88f; }
.rv-denba-values h3 { font-size:16px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.9; }
.rv-denba-values p { font-size:14px; line-height:1.9; color:#e1e2d7; }
.rv-denba-grid>div>p.rv-denba-attribution { font-size:13px; line-height:1.9; color:#d2d2c6; margin-top:21px; }
.rv-denba-adoption { display:grid; grid-template-columns:39% 61%; gap:0; padding:32px 0; margin-top:46px; border-top:1px solid #737967; }
.rv-denba-adoption>div:first-child { padding-right:64px; }
.rv-denba-adoption h3 { font-family:var(--rv-serif); font-size:22px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.8; margin-top:12px; }
.rv-denba-adoption p { font-size:15px; line-height:2; }
.rv-denba-adoption p.rv-label { font-size:12px; }
.rv-denba-adoption p.rv-small { font-size:12px; line-height:1.9; margin-top:13px; }
.rv-adoption-sources { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; column-gap:28px; }
.rv-denba-details { border-color:#737967; }
.rv-denba-details>div { max-width:70em; }
@media(max-width:1100px){
 .rv-denba-grid,.rv-denba-adoption { grid-template-columns:35% 65%; }
 .rv-denba-media { margin-right:34px; }
 .rv-denba-adoption>div:first-child { padding-right:34px; }
 .rv-denba-values>div { grid-template-columns:22px 150px 1fr; gap:12px; }
 .rv-denba-values h3 { font-size:15px; }
 .rv-denba-values p { font-size:13px; }
 .rv-explainer-head h3 { font-size:27px; }
}
@media(max-width:800px){
 .rv-scene { width:140px; height:98px; margin-bottom:22px; }
 .rv-denba-grid,.rv-denba-adoption { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
 .rv-denba-grid>div:last-child { grid-row:1; }
 .rv-denba-media { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:32px; margin:34px 0 0; }
 .rv-denba-grid .rv-denba-product { grid-template-columns:1fr; align-content:start; margin-top:0; gap:15px; }
 .rv-denba .rv-denba-product>img { width:100%; height:250px; }
 .rv-denba .rv-denba-product figcaption { margin:0; }
 .rv-denba-svg { max-width:220px; }
 .rv-denba-values>div { grid-template-columns:25px 160px 1fr; gap:18px; }
 .rv-denba-adoption>div:first-child { padding:0; }
 .rv-denba-adoption>div+div { margin-top:23px; }
 .rv-oxygen-compare { gap:20px; }
 .rv-oxygen-compare>figure { padding:23px; }
 .rv-compare-top { flex-direction:column; gap:8px; }
 .rv-oxygen-compare figcaption strong { font-size:16px; }
 .rv-oxygen-compare figcaption p { font-size:14px; }
 .rv-explainer-head>p:not(.rv-label) { font-size:15px; }
}
@media(max-width:600px){
 .rv-hero-lead { font-size:14px; }
 .rv-benefit-grid article { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 108px; gap:0 14px; padding-top:28px; padding-bottom:26px; }
 .rv-benefit-grid .rv-scene { grid-column:2; grid-row:1/3; align-self:center; width:108px; height:76px; margin:0; }
 .rv-benefit-grid .rv-label { grid-column:1; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.03em; }
 .rv-benefit-grid h3 { grid-column:1; font-size:25px; margin:15px 0 21px; }
 .rv-benefit-grid article>p:not(.rv-label) { grid-column:1/-1; font-size:15px; max-width:none; }
 .rv-oxygen-explainer { margin-top:36px; padding-top:35px; }
 .rv-explainer-head h3 { font-size:24px; line-height:1.65; margin-bottom:23px; }
 .rv-mobile-break { display:initial; }
 .rv-oxygen-compare { grid-template-columns:1fr; margin-top:26px; gap:16px; }
 .rv-oxygen-compare>figure { padding:21px 23px 24px; }
 .rv-compare-top { flex-direction:row; gap:12px; }
 .rv-compare-top strong { font-size:17px; }
 .rv-compare-top span { font-size:10px; }
 .rv-oxygen-svg { max-width:300px; margin-top:18px; margin-bottom:15px; }
 .rv-oxygen-compare figcaption strong { font-size:16px; }
 .rv-oxygen-compare figcaption p { margin-top:11px; font-size:14px; }
 .rv-diagram-key { font-size:12px; gap:8px; }
 .rv-diagram-note,.rv-supporting-note { font-size:12px; line-height:1.95; }
 .rv-energy { gap:10px; }
 .rv-energy>span { font-size:14px; }
 .rv-energy p { font-size:12px; }
 .rv-denba h2 { font-size:27px; line-height:1.65; }
 .rv-denba-values>div { grid-template-columns:23px 1fr; gap:4px 12px; padding:17px 0; }
 .rv-denba-values h3 { font-size:16px; }
 .rv-denba-values p { grid-column:2; font-size:14px; }
 .rv-denba-grid>div>p.rv-denba-attribution { font-size:12px; }
 .rv-denba-media { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:22px; }
 .rv-denba-diagram { padding:23px 18px 22px; }
 .rv-denba-svg { max-width:235px; }
 .rv-denba-diagram figcaption { font-size:11px; }
 .rv-denba-grid .rv-denba-product { grid-template-columns:85px 1fr; gap:16px; }
 .rv-denba .rv-denba-product>img { width:85px; height:98px; }
 .rv-denba-adoption { margin-top:34px; padding-top:27px; }
 .rv-denba-adoption h3 { font-size:22px; }
 .rv-denba-adoption>div+div { margin-top:20px; }
 .rv-adoption-sources { display:block; }
}
@media(max-width:360px){
 .rv-benefit-grid article { grid-template-columns:1fr 85px; gap:0 10px; }
 .rv-benefit-grid .rv-scene { width:85px; height:66px; }
 .rv-benefit-grid h3 { font-size:22px; }
 .rv-denba h2 { font-size:24px; }
 .rv-explainer-head h3 { font-size:22px; }
 .rv-compare-top strong { font-size:16px; }
}

.rv-benefit-grid .rv-illustration-slot>img { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; }
